attestations.text: CH'ÊN Chi-ju 陳繼儒 (T. 仲醇, H. 眉公, 糜道人), Dec. 16, 1558–1639, Oct. 19, writer and artist, was a native of Hua-t'ing, Kiangsu. Never passing beyond the licentiate in his examination career, he built a home in the hills of his native district known as Shê-shan 佘山, and earned his living by private teaching, by composing books of a popular character, and by writing epitaphs and birthday congratulations.
